About This Demo

Play as Hendra, a man on a mission for revenge. Infiltrating a hidden, illegal factory, you'll come face-to-face with Jagal, one of those responsible for your family’s murder. Engage in close-quarters combat and uncover dark secrets as you take the first steps on your path to vengeance.

Story Mission

Experience a compelling, demo-exclusive mission where Hendra infiltrates a dangerous illegal factory to confront Jagal, the man responsible for your family's murder. Navigate intense close-quarters combat, face deadly enemies, and uncover the dark secrets within this criminal operation.

Arena Mode

Test your skills in arena mode, where you’ll face relentless waves of enemies. This fast-paced combat experience challenges you to hone your tactics and strive for high scores unique to the demo.

Limited Outfit Selection

Personalize Hendra’s appearance with a selection of demo-only outfits. Each option allows you to style Hendra to match your gameplay approach, giving a glimpse of the customization available in the full game.

Achievements

Unlock up to 10 demo-specific achievements tied to the story mission, arena scores, and combat challenges, encouraging you to fully explore and master the demo experience.

Key Features

  • Demo-exclusive story mission with unique objectives and enemies
  • Arena mode featuring wave-based combat and high score challenges
  • Limited outfit customization to personalize Hendra’s look
  • Unlockable achievements tied to the story mission, arena scores, and combat challenges
